description: Historical read-only performance baseline before production native sampler integration. This exact source already includes separate IPv4 and IPv6 netstat reads; process and file-lock sampling use PowerShell plus Add-Type. It is not the current windows-platform implementation.
limitations: Other historical exports remain in the byte-identical source for reproducibility, but the harness does not expose or call them. No current production sampler dependency may be imported by this baseline.
